theme: A travel day — St. Pete to Toronto for ICGN.
greeting: The morning is open to pack up and check out of the Coffee Pot Bayou cottage; the afternoon takes you north on Porter PD526, with the ICGN Board Dinner waiting tomorrow evening.

needsAttention.title: Arrive at the ICGN dinner holding a short list
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow evening's ICGN Board Dinner at Lee Restaurant is a block from your loft. Worth landing in Toronto with two or three people you want to find and a clear line on the board work you're after next.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV before it's gone
needsAttention.detail: A p1 on the Mike + Dan board, overdue since Sept 14: a full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week — the only six-seater up there once the Pathfinder heads south. Holiday inventory at PWM sells out; a refundable hold ends the risk.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December holiday trip
needsAttention.detail: Also overdue (p2): shortlist and decide the Dec 13 – Jan 2 trip for all six. Holiday inventory for that many over three weeks is the year's thinnest, and the decision has waited since Sept 30.

schedule.title: Check out of the Coffee Pot Bayou cottage

flagged.title: Two statements now available
flagged.detail: Morgan Stanley and Revolut monthly statements posted — FYI, nothing to action.

flagged.title: LinkedIn activity, automated only
flagged.detail: A job alert (a Meta partnerships role) and one connection invite — no recruiter outreach or replies needing you.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promos — Foreign Affairs, Responsible Investor, Italian/Japanese word-of-the-day, a few retailers — plus Airbnb and travel confirmations.
inbox.clear: No security mail, and nothing is waiting on your reply.

recipe.title: Chanterelle salad
recipe.why: Autumn is peak foraging season, when wild chanterelles are at their earthy best.

tasks.title: Get three term-life quotes for Mike
Place the Portland house order (bedframe + outdoor shower soap holder)
Mike: call the dermatologist to book wart-removal appt
Drive the Pathfinder down, Portland → St Pete

acts.line: Open in St. Pete — room to pack, close loose ends, and check in before you leave.
Porter PD526 lifts off at 4:20 for Toronto, landing around 7:17.
Settle into the Richmond St loft; the ICGN conference week begins tomorrow.
